page0.text:
"..."
This isn't something I should be agonizing over.
I'm an amateur, while Tohsaka is a first-rate mage and Master.
Given what happened last night, teaming up with her is clearly the wiser choice.
But...
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page0:1

page1.text:
"Emiya. I want to hear your answer."
"..."
Doing it right now feels like jumping the gun.
I don't think Tohsaka is trying to deceive me, but I should figure things out on my own first.
Otherwise, I won't know right from wrong.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page1:1

page2.text:
"...Sorry, Tohsaka.
I appreciate your concern, but I can't give you the answer you want. As heavy as this whole thing is, I don't think I should just jump to a decision here."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page2:1

page3.text:
I meet her glare and dig my proverbial heels in.
Tohsaka slightly narrows her eyes, then gives an emotionless nod.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page3:1

page4.text: "Then I guess that's it. Though you're right about one thing. If you really want to win, you can't trust anyone."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page4:1

page5.text: "That isn't true. I trust you, Tohsaka. I just don't think I can make this decision on my own. If I'm Saber's Master, then I shouldn't make commitments without looping her in."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page5:1

page6.text: "I see. You're right. You are a Master now."
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page6:1

page7.text:
Tohsaka nods again in acceptance and quickly turns away.
Her long hair sways as she walks away.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page7:1

page8.text:
With that, the girl who might have been my ally turns back...
"See you around. Next time, we'll meet as enemies."
...and leaves me with a cold warning, just like Illya did.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page8:1

page9.text:
"Okay."
I take a quick breath and try to organize my thoughts.
I haven't even had time to think since witnessing that fight between Lancer and Archer back at the school.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page9:1

page10.text:
Lancer stabbed me in the chest at school. Somehow I survived and got home. Then Lancer attacked me again...
"Saber saved me, and I became a Master."
So then I had things explained at the church.
The Holy Grail War, a battle to the death.
A Holy Grail...a device said to grant any wish to the victor.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page10:1

page11.text:
There's so much I still don't understand, but I have a reliable guide to help me out.
"Yeah, I should go and talk to Saber first."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page11:1

page12.text:
After making a full round of the house,
Saber is nowhere to be found. I even checked the detached guest rooms, but I can't find her.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page12:1

page13.text: "That's weird. That armor isn't exactly camouflage..."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page13:1

page14.text:
Even so, a fully armed and armored Saber still eludes me.
Supposedly Servants can turn into spirit forms, but unfortunately she can't with me.
No, first of all...
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page14:1

page15.text: "Even though I'm called a Master, I don't know anything about her."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page15:1

page16.text:
I don't even know what Saber is or how Servants are able to exist.
The one thing I do know is...
It really doesn't matter how much stronger or better someone is. They can be wounded in a fight, and they bleed when they're wounded.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page16:1

page17.text:
"Oh..."
Saber is in the still, silent dojo.
She looks different than she had last night.
Saber is sitting upright, her legs tucked beneath herself, on the wooden floor. She's not wearing her armor.
She changed into rather elegant clothes that really suited her. Now she sits in wait.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page17:1

page18.text:
...
...Words fail me at the sight.
Saber looks beautiful. She strikes a refined, dignified figure as she sits there, eyes closed.
She seems to almost merge with the silence, like nothing so much as still water.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page18:1

page19.text:
...
And that rids me of any further doubt in my mind.
Servant or whatever it is, she seems sacrosanct.
So... From now on, I'm sure I won't go down the wrong path.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page19:1

page20.text:
"Saber."
I call to her.
Saber calmly opens her eyes and meets my gaze.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page20:1

page21.text:
"You are awake, Shirou."
Her voice is serene.
Something rich and calm about her voice hangs in the air.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page21:1

page22.text:
"Yeah, I just woke up. What are you doing here?"
"I was resting. Since I cannot treat you, I figured that I would at least ensure that my body is in as perfect a condition as I can make it."
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page22:1

page23.text:
"..."
Saber gives a straightforward response as she scrutinizes me.
...This is, um...
Making me nervous in a different way than Tohsaka did.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page23:1

page24.text:
"Shirou? What is it? Is your body still...?"
"N-no, I'm totally fine...! It's something else, really, it's nothing...!"
I quickly take a step back and shake my head.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page24:1

page25.text:
"Hm?"
Looking away from Saber—who tilts her head at me quizzically—I try to calm my rapid heartbeat.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page25:1

page26.text:
"Get a hold of yourself! Why are you getting worked up like this...!"
I take a deep breath.
...But I don't think this feeling is going away anytime soon.
"...Man, why did she have to change...?"
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page26:1

page27.text:
I can't help myself.
With Saber in that outfit, I can't help but actually think she's real now.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page27:1

page28.text:
...Seriously, she's drop-dead gorgeous.
I mean I saw that yesterday, but it's actually setting in now.
And seeing her dress in a girlish outfit like that makes it really difficult for a normal boy my age to act properly.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page28:1

page29.text:
"Shirou."
As soon as we make eye contact I can feel my nervousness grow.
Then again, I wasn't looking everywhere for her just to stay silent. It's uncomfortable, but I can't let it be awkward forever.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page29:1

page30.text:
"All right.
May I, Saber? This is the first time for us to sit down and actually figure things out, but..."
I bite the bullet.
But then...
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page30:1

page31.text:
"Shirou. Before that, there is something that I would address regarding last night."
She interrupts me, obviously displeased, making her earlier calm hard to fathom.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page31:1

page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page32:1

page33.text:
"As I said: last night.
You are my Master. It is troubling if you take such actions. Combat is my territory, so please stay behind me and out of the direct line of fire. I cannot protect you when you go out on your own, apparently determined to die in vain as you so nearly did."
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page33:1

page34.text:
Saber doesn't mince words.
Her clipped tone is enough to make me forget my anxiety.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page34:1

page35.text: "Wh-what the hell! If I hadn't intervened, you'd have been cut in half!"
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page35:1

page36.text:
"Perhaps I would have died. But you would not have been hurt.
Let me repeat myself. Do not do that again.
My Master need not defend me, nor is there any reason to do so."
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page36:1

page37.text: "Wha... Don't be stupid! I don't need a reason to protect a girl!"
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page37:1

page38.text:
Saber stiffens, as if surprised to see me upset at her.
Then her look becomes one of indescribable dignity.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page38:1

page39.text:
"Uh..."
I find myself taking a step back under her severe expression.
Now I just feel embarrassed, like I've said something incredibly tone-deaf.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page39:1

page40.text: "A-anyway, thanks for taking me home. I appreciate that."
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page40:1

page41.text:
I turn around and thank her.
...It's embarrassing enough to thank her like this, but in this situation it feels even more awkward.
Even so, it's only right to thank the person who saved my life.
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page41:1

page42.text:
"You are most welcome. It is a Servant's duty to protect their Master, but it is still nice to be acknowledged. You are very courteous, Shirou."
"I don't think I'm particularly polite, actually."
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page42:1

page43.text: There's something more pressing that I need to bring up.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page43:1

page44.text:
"Let's get back on topic, Saber.
Oh, um, I can call you Saber, right?"
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page44:1

page45.text:
"Yes. As a Servant who has formed a contract with you, I am your sword. I shall follow your orders, attack your enemies, and protect you."
Saber does not hesitate in the slightest to give her answer.
Her tone leaves no room for doubt.
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page45:1

page46.text:
"You are my sword, huh? To win the Holy Grail thing?"
"Is that not why you summoned me?"
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page46:1

page47.text:
"No, actually. It was just a coincidence.
You may have figured this out, but I'm not a full-fledged mage. I'm sorry, but I have no real knowledge or power as a Master.
But, now that I've decided to, I'll fight. I'm inexperienced as a Master, but are you okay with that?"
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page47:1

page48.text:
"Of course. You are my Master, Shirou.
That is an immutable fact. Servants do not have the freedom to choose their Masters."
...
I didn't know that.
If it's true, I'll need to respect Saber's needs and actions as best I can.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page48:1

page49.text: "Got it. Then you're okay with me being your Master, Saber?"
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page49:1

page50.text:
"Yes. However, Shirou, I will not allow defeat.
If you do not have any chance, it is my duty to carve out a path to victory. I will use any means possible to have you win the Holy Grail.
We Servants do not serve our Masters out of charity. We serve you because we also desire the Holy Grail."
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page50:1

page51.text: "...Huh? Hold on, you mean you want the Holy Grail too...!?"
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page51:1

page52.text:
"Of course. Originally, the only ones who can touch the Holy Grail's spiritual form are Servants, who are also spirits.
The Master who is victorious in the Holy Grail War will obtain the Holy Grail through their Servant. Afterwards, the Servant's wish will be granted in repayment.
That is the nature of the relationship between Servant and Master."
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page52:1

page53.text:
...
...Oh.
Come to think of it, there's no reason these absurdly strong Heroic Spirits would listen to humans, normally.
They have their own reasons for serving Masters.
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page53:1

page54.text:
Which means Saber has a wish she wants granted.
That's why Saber doesn't hesitate to fight, even if her Master is as incomplete as I am.
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page54:1

page55.text:
"Okay then, can I ask one more thing?
You said Masters are mages who summon Servants, right?
I get that, but I still don't quite understand your side of things. I do know that Saber and Lancer aren't your real names, though."
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page55:1

page56.text: "Yes, those are only names that are given based on each of our roles. ...All right, I shall use this as an opportunity to give a rough explanation."
page56.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page56:1

page57.text:
"We Servants are Heroic Spirits.
Each of us made a name for ourselves in our respective time periods; we accomplished some great deed beyond human capabilities.
Whatever the means, we are beings who have sublimated to deity-esque status."
page57.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page57:1

page58.text:
That much is obvious.
Heroic Spirits had supernatural abilities while they were alive, were celebrated after their deaths, and promoted to a higher spiritual rank than a ghost or such.
page58.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page58:1

page59.text:
"But at the same time, that is also our weakness. Because Heroic Spirits each left a mark upon history, our weaknesses were also recorded.
By revealing our names and identities, we would be revealing our weaknesses."
page59.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page59:1

page60.text: "...I see. Heroes usually do have some opponent that they are weak against. So that's why you're using a name like Saber and concealing your real name."
page60.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page60:1

page61.text:
"Yes. However, that is not the only reason I am called Saber.
There are seven Servants who were called forth by the Holy Grail, and each of them are all selected according to their class."
page61.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page61:1

page62.text: "Class...? So that's where Saber and Archer come from?"
page62.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page62:1

page63.text:
"That is correct. First of all, summoning a Heroic Spirit is itself close to a miracle. To summon seven of them is too much even for the Holy Grail.
In order to solve that, the Holy Grail prepares seven vessels beforehand and only calls forth Heroic Spirits who are compatible with those vessels. Such vessels are like objects that keep us temporarily bound to this world.
They are the seven classes:
page63.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page63:1

page64.text:
Saber,
Lancer,
Archer,
Rider,
Caster,
Assassin,
and Berserker.
page64.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page64:1

page65.text:
"The Holy Grail calls forth Heroic Spirits with abilities that correspond to each role from any time period.
And those who are assigned to these classes are called Servants."
page65.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page65:1

page66.text:
"...I get it. So you're a Saber because you're a Heroic Spirit who was good with a sword."
"Correct. There may be some Heroic Spirits who possess multiple attributes, but I would say in all humility that there are none better than I with the sword."
page66.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page66:1

page67.text:
"However, that is also my disadvantage.
I am not a mage, so I can only defeat enemies as your sword."
page67.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page67:1

page68.text: "You mean you're not good at the cloak and dagger stuff. I don't consider that a weakness. You're more than strong enough as a Saber."
page68.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page68:1

page69.text:
"Shirou, battles are not won through might alone.
This is hypothetical, but if your enemy is better at close combat than you, then what would you do?"
page69.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page69:1

page70.text: "Huh? Well, I guess... I know that I wouldn't be able to win if I just fight head-on, so I would have to do something without fighting..."
page70.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page70:1

page71.text:
I understand once I say that.
If the opponent is strong, of course you wouldn't pick a direct fight with them.
Defeating opponents with a sword isn't the only way to fight.
If you can't beat your opponent with a sword, you just have to come up with another way.
page71.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page71:1

page72.text: "That is correct. If your opponent discovers that you are skilled in close combat, then they will most likely not challenge you thusly. In that sense, Servants who lack ability will use any means possible."
page72.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page72:1

page73.text:
"The Assassin Servant lacks combat capacity but has the ability to hide its presence, and the Caster Servant is proficient in magecraft that does not exist in this age.
You cannot be optimistic from power difference. Additionally, we have things called 'Noble Phantasms.' No matter what kind of Servant we are, as Heroic Spirits, we have the opportunity to create a fatal attack."
page73.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page73:1

page74.text:
"Noble Phantasm...?"
I've not heard the term.
Though I think I can glean the meaning from the words.
page74.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page74:1

page75.text:
"Noble Phantasms are special weapons that Servants have.
Weapons like Lancer's spear, Archer's bow, and my sword are all such treasured tools.
Heroes do not become so by themselves. It is due to their chosen weapon, the very symbol of their existence, that they are recognized as heroes."
page75.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page75:1

page76.text:
"Heroes and their armaments are one. As such, those who become Heroic Spirits bear famed and powerful weapons.
That is what Noble Phantasms are: a Servant's trump card. They are also what we need to fear most."
page76.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page76:1

page77.text:
...
...Saber says that Noble Phantasms are weapons that Heroic Spirits had while they were alive.
page77.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page77:1

page78.text:
I recall that blue knight's spear.
It sucked up all the magical energy in the air and stabbed Saber's chest with an impossible trajectory.
That thing is certainly not something that a normal human can handle.
The spear itself carried a strong curse, but I felt an amount of magical energy on another level from the words Lancer said back then too.
Could that be...
page78.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page78:1

page79.text:
"Saber. Are Noble Phantasms magecraft?
Lancer's spear certainly seemed like something with history, but the spear itself was not extraordinary.
But with his words, the spear went beyond the realm of weapons. Isn't that a type of magecraft?"
page79.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page79:1

page80.text:
"Yes, Noble Phantasms are certainly similar to magecraft.
As you say, Lancer's spear. It is a Noble Phantasm, but its true value is demonstrated only when he puts magical energy into it and says its True Name."
page80.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page80:1

page81.text:
"Noble Phantasms are technically Mystics that are materialized.
Just as incantations are necessary to activate magecraft, Noble Phantasms also need their True Name to be recited in order to awaken and activate them.
However, this also has its dangers. By saying the True Name of the Noble Phantasm, that Servant's identity will be revealed."
page81.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page81:1

page82.text:
"I get it. Heroes and weapons are a set. If you know the name of the weapon, you can work out who wields it."
Saber nods in silence.
page82.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page82:1

page83.text:
That is why the Noble Phantasm is a trump card.
In exchange for revealing their identity, it would launch an unavoidable fatal blow.
And if that attack misses or fails, the Servant has revealed their weaknesses.
page83.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page83:1

page84.text: "So, Saber. Is your Noble Phantasm that invisible sword?"
page84.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page84:1

page85.text:
"...Yes. However, I have not revealed its identity yet. At this point, there should not be any Servants who know my True Name."
With that, Saber looks away uncomfortably for a second.
page85.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page85:1

page86.text:
"Shirou. I have a request about that matter."
"Huh? What kind of request?"
page86.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page86:1

page87.text:
"It's about my True Name. Normally Servants reveal their True Name only to their Master, so they can plan strategies for the battles ahead.
However, you are inexperienced as a mage.
If you encounter a superior mage, they should be able to read your mind. Therefore..."
page87.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page87:1

page88.text:
"Ah, so you can't reveal your name, huh? Yeah, you're right. Like hypnosis or being hit with a Whisper-type spell, or... Well, I doubt it, but if other Masters have Mystic Eyes, then I might start babbling about it.
Okay then. I'll leave it up to you to decide when to use your Noble Phantasm."
page88.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page88:1

page89.text:
"Ah... Are you certain you should make such a rash decision?"
"It's not rash. I thought it over, and I'm satisfied by the conclusion I reached.
I did think it through, so don't worry."
...
page89.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page89:1

page90.text:
Moving on.
We've talked through most things, but I still don't think I understand the whole situation.
page90.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page90:1

page91.text: "Hey Saber. Do Masters or Servants have some sort of mark? I don't really know what I should be doing."
page91.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page91:1

page92.text:
"No, unfortunately there is no definitive way to identify them.
But if other Servants are near, a Servant can sense their presence. All the more so if they are in physical form. Servants themselves are a powerful force of magical energy.
You were able to sense Berserker's presence, correct?"
page92.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page92:1

page93.text: "Ugh... That's true. It would be bad if I can only tell once I'm attacked, right? I need to at least notice before they approach, or else I won't be able to take some kind of countermeasure."
page93.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page93:1

page94.text:
"Then, how about tracking the Master's presence? Masters are mages. Since they use magecraft for a living, there will always be magical energy that is leaking. If you search for that, you may be able to identify the Master's whereabouts."
"...Sorry. Unfortunately, I can't do anything requiring skills like that."
page94.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page94:1

page95.text:
I mean, I didn't even realize Tohsaka's identity, and we go to the same school.
We were in the same building for two years, and on top of that, I saw her many times.
page95.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page95:1

page96.text:
"...Damn. No wonder I get made fun of for being an amateur. My only proof as Master is my Command Spell. It looks like I have a tough road ahead of me."
I sigh heavily.
And then,
page96.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page96:1

page97.text:
"Shirou. Can you close your eyes for a moment?"
Saber's face is stern as she speaks.
"Hm...? Close my eyes? Why?"
"I am going to prove that you are a Master. Just listen to me. Close your eyes and regulate your breathing."
page97.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page97:1

page98.text:
"..."
...I close my eyes.
I feel something slightly touching my forehead.
Wait, it's oddly pointed, could it be the end of her sword...!?
page98.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page98:1

page99.text:
"...Saber? Hold on, are you sure you're not doing anything weird?"
"...Master, please be quiet and concentrate on my fingertip. If you are a mage, you should be able to feel my magical energy from that."
page99.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page99:1

page100.text:
"...Mrgh."
Oh, so it's Saber's finger touching me.
I pull myself together and quiet my mind.
page100.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page100:1

page101.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page101:1

page102.text:
"Saber, what was that?"
"Is it not obvious? You and I are connected through a contract, so it is natural to understand my condition."
page102.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page102:1

page103.text:
"Understand your condition...?"
"I do not know how you saw it. Your standards are what sets how you measure a Servant's ability. There are some Masters who distinguish simply through colors, and there are other Masters who understand by comparing them to beasts."
page103.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page103:1

page104.text:
"In other words, it varies by person, but one perceives it in the easiest way for them to identify.
This is the basics of being a Master, so from now on, please check frequently. You should be able to understand the details of someone after seeing them once."
page104.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page104:1

page105.text:
...I think I get it now.
I was surprised because it was so sudden, but I might be able to act a bit more like a Master now.
page105.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page105:1

page106.text:
"...Master. This concludes my abbreviated explanation."
"Yeah. It's a lot to take in, but it makes sense. Sorry for the trouble, Saber."
page106.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page106:1

page107.text:
"...There is no need to apologize.
You need to understand the situation we're in to make decisions about our next steps."
page107.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page107:1

page108.text:
Saber leans forward attentively, awaiting my next words.
This tells me...
Saber is probably the same as Tohsaka: she's the sort to strike first.
page108.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page108:1

page109.text:
"Well, I don't think we'll do anything particularly different.
I don't plan to go looking for other Masters to defeat them, like Tohsaka."
page109.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page109:1

page110.text:
"Shirou, that is not what we just talked about. Do you not have any intention of pursuing the Holy Grail in your capacity as a Master?"
Saber's eyes narrow.
Those eyes are those of a cool-headed knight that does not accept any disagreement.
page110.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page110:1

page111.text:
...
I stare back, trying not to let myself be intimidated, and clearly convey my intentions.
page111.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page111:1

page112.text:
"Of course I do. But only because I don't want it to fall into the wrong hands. I don't really have any particular reason to want the Holy Grail for myself."
"Nnn...!"
page112.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page112:1

page113.text:
"But that doesn't mean I'm not going to fight.
I'm a mage, even if I'm an amateur. I know I can't back out of this situation now, and that I won't make it out alive if I just sit and do nothing."
page113.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page113:1

page114.text: "So in this battle that you cannot avoid as a mage... Instead of fighting to obtain the Holy Grail, are you saying that you are fighting to prevent the conflict over the Holy Grail?"
page114.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page114:1

page115.text: "Huh? Well, I guess that's what it means. Yeah, that's it. I can't really explain it, but I feel like that's something worth fighting for."
page115.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page115:1

page116.text:
Yeah.
Honestly, the idea of a Holy Grail doesn't feel real to me.
But preventing battles? That, I can fight my hardest for, and do it with pride.
page116.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page116:1

page117.text: "...I don't understand. You say that you are a mage. If so, you should desire the omnipotence of the Holy Grail. Do mages not master their craft because they have a wish that they cannot grant themselves?"
page117.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page117:1

page118.text:
"I'm not sure what you're saying. I don't have unfulfillable wishes. I do have a lot of things that I have to do, though."
Yeah.
That's why I need to do everything in my power to keep innocent people out of this battle.
page118.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page118:1

page119.text:
"Does that mean you do not need the Holy Grail? You will not fight for it?"
"That's not what I'm saying. I have every intention of getting the Holy Grail since I'm going to fight."
page119.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page119:1

page120.text:
"Your words are contradictory. Why would you bother fighting for something you have no need of?"
"Hm?"
Well, because...
Winning means you get the Holy Grail. And most of all...
page120.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page120:1

page121.text:
"You need it, right? Then we have to get it."
...
page121.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page121:1

page122.text:
"Yeah, I don't know what kind of people the other Masters are like.
Some of them may be really good people.
But I decided I'm going to be on your side. And if you say you want the Holy Grail, then I'll give it my all to help you."
...
page122.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page122:1

page123.text:
"...Um, I'm only echoing my old man's opinion, but if you want to champion justice, you need to be an egoist.
It's pointless to support everybody, so you need to ally yourself only with people that you like and trust."
page123.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page123:1

page124.text:
"I never thought of it that way, but now I think I should.
I can't just fight for myself.
But what I can do is fight for you, Saber."
page124.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page124:1

page125.text:
And to be honest...
If it's something this girl wants that seriously, it's only natural to want to obtain it for her no matter what.
...I mean, don't all guys think that way?
page125.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page125:1

page126.text:
"Does that mean you would forfeit the fight if I give up the Holy Grail?"
"...Hm."
I wouldn't want that.
But if Saber does that, everything I thought of so far falls apart.
page126.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page126:1

page127.text:
"No. It doesn't matter. I already said I would fight.
That's why I won't run away. I've already decided, Saber."
I look at her straight in the eye as I declare this.
Saber doesn't respond immediately. She takes a deep breath, then looks at me.
page127.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page127:1

page128.text:
"Understood. If you say so as a Master, I simply have to obey. My objective is the Holy Grail, while your goal is to stop the battle. Our ultimate destination is still the same.
...But I must say one thing, Shirou."
page128.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page128:1

page129.text:
Saber stops abruptly.
She seems to look far into the distance.
"I struggle to put it into words, but I believe you will come to regret what you've said. In fact, I'm sure of it."
So she says.
page129.sourceUnit: セイバールート四日目-05:page129:1
